description: [PREMIUM — needs an API key: call hl_request_free_key first for a free key, or pay per call via x402] Register a persistent alert the server evaluates on a schedule; fired events are retrieved with hl_poll_alerts. Types: funding_apr (|annualized funding| crosses a threshold), price_move (|return| over a window), whale_net_flip (cohort net position flips long/short). Turns the server into a market watcher for your agent. Analytics only, not investment advice.
